verdict.rationale: Jev documents an explicit LLM-guardrails cookbook for screening every message going into and out of an LLM app. It thresholds hazard probabilities and severity to pass, review, block or route, and a confidence-routing pattern decides whether to act on an answer; a citation-check cookbook and a third-party list of 28 'Verification & Guardrails' projects reinforce this. A community report that probabilities shift when choices are reordered and that confidence adds no information weakens trust in the gating signal, and the vendor's own limitations page flags adversarial content as a weak spot, but neither contradicts that the pattern exists. Missing for 10: a dedicated moderation endpoint or built-in safety settings, independent hands-on corroboration that the guardrail pattern works, and resolution of the calibration concerns behind threshold-based gating.
